value.body: IRCTC, the Indian Railways catering and tourism company, engages Hospitality Monitors on contract to supervise food production, quality and service in train pantry cars and static catering units, handle passenger complaints and check compliance. Recruitment is through zone-wise walk-in interviews.

items.label: Engagement
items.note: Extendable by 1 year; not a permanent post

items.label: Pay
items.note: Plus on-board daily allowance as per policy
items.source: IRCTC West Zone Hospitality Monitor notification, 11-06-2025

items.label: Upper age limit
items.note: Relaxation for SC/ST, OBC, PwBD and ex-servicemen
items.source: IRCTC West Zone Hospitality Monitor notification, 11-06-2025

value.title: How you get in
value.body: A full-time B.Sc in Hospitality & Hotel Administration from an NCHMCT-affiliated institute, or another listed hotel management / culinary degree. Walk-in interview at the zonal venue; some notices also ask for prior experience. A security deposit was required on selection in recent notices.

value.title: At a glance
items: The job is contractual and does not lead to a regular IRCTC post.
It involves on-board travel and postings across several states in the zone.
Terms differ by zone and year, so read the specific notice.
